native_concat_information: At gamma0, semantic_fusion(X)=X. Native fc_after_concat(flatten(transpose(X))) can already represent linear typed contrasts.
coordinate_example: With dropout off and gamma0, independently permute output hidden coordinates in each final LinearPerMetapath map, permute corresponding LayerNorm affine parameters, and compensate the concatenation weight columns with the inverse induced flattened-coordinate permutation. Global LayerNorm moments and elementwise PReLU commute with permutation; the native deterministic predictor is unchanged. The sum/contrast projector comparing corresponding token coordinates generally changes.
coordinate_limits: No arbitrary independent-rotation equivalence for full nonlinear trained attention or fixed dropout replay is asserted. No numerical equivalence test was run.
site_ambiguity: Post-semantic fc_after_concat LoRA consumes mixed attention tokens; pre-semantic-token skip adapter consumes original projected tokens. They differ for gamma≠0.
generic_prior_limit: Cross-view target alignment, activation covariance and orthogonal dictionaries are established/general operations. Graph preprocessing inputs alone do not prove a new graph-specific mechanism.
warm_state_limit: Gamma-zero source counterexample does not disqualify every competent warm state with learned attention; meaningful token-coordinate alignment remains unestablished.
